profile_name.description: The human-readable name of the backup profile.

source_dir.description: The local directory path to source files from.

dest_dir.description: The local or network directory path to destination files.

exclude_patterns.description: List of file patterns or paths to exclude from the backup/sync operation.

dry_run.description: If true, executes the profile in simulation mode without making changes.

skip_critical.description: If true, proceeds with tasks even if they trigger CRITICAL warnings.

silent.description: If true, runs in silent mode (tray notification only).

console_mode.description: If true, forces console mode execution instead of GUI.

no_questions.description: If true, skips interactive confirmation prompts.
